sentences.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.
sentences.zh: 医生坚持让病人多休息。

sentences.en: Some people insist that television does more harm than good.
sentences.zh: 有些人坚持认为电视比有益处。

sentences.en: He insists on going to the park with his father.
sentences.zh: 他坚持要和父亲一起去公园。

senses.zh: 坚持,强调,坚决要求,坚决认为
